Leash checks at closing stayed on our minds, and we value your review. We are sorry that your recent experience did not meet the standard you expected from Aurelia Skyways, especially where the handling of your companion animal and the consistency of our service left you feeling unsettled. We understand how important calm, careful support is when traveling with a pet, and we take your concerns seriously.

Our Companion Animal Travel Desk works closely with a welfare coordinator to review comfort needs, handling steps, and boarding arrangements so that each animal is treated with steady care. When a trip does not reflect that goal, we look into the details with the staff involved and check where our process may have slipped. That review helps us understand whether communication was unclear, whether a handoff was delayed, or whether the care plan was not followed as intended.

We also want to reassure you that dependable companion travel is a priority across our team. That includes paying attention to crate placement, calm transfer routines, and the condition of the waiting area before departure. If your complaint concerned a pet's comfort, we appreciate you bringing it forward, because those reports help us improve both the travel experience and the follow-through at the desk.

We are sorry for the frustration this caused, and we regret any worry you had while traveling. Your comments have been shared with the service team so the matter can be addressed and so similar concerns can be reduced for future travelers and their animals. We remain committed to clearer communication, kinder handling, and more dependable support for every journey.

Thank you for writing to Aurelia Skyways and for giving us the chance to respond. We hope to do better on your next trip, and we appreciate the opportunity to restore your confidence in our care. Companion Animal Travel Desk
